    b=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(v==2 for v in r)]; return [r[1:-1] for r in grid[b[0]+1:b[-1]]]"},{"nl":"Crop between horizontal bars of 2 and preserve all non-frame columns between the two edge 2s.","code":"def transform(grid):

    b=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(v==2 for v in r)]; c=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(grid[i][j]==2 for i in range(len(grid)))]; return [r[c[0]+1:c[-1]] for r in grid[b[0]+1:b[-1]]]"}]}
